title: Cross-repo handoff receipt
description: What ai-editorial-system hands to suengj-com for one article (AES-P6.1 / SUE-459). Checked before a suengj-com change is opened. The receipt describes the handoff; suengj-com remains the publication authority and may still refuse it.

schema_version.description: Contract version. suengj-com declares the major versions it accepts; a major mismatch is refused rather than guessed at.

status.description: Always draft on handoff. Publication is a separate human act inside suengj-com.

front_matter.description: The values to write into the canonical Markdown. Plain data only — nothing here requires editorial-system code to interpret.

body_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical Markdown body being handed over, so the receipt cannot drift from the file.

artifacts.description: Optional dependencies. An empty list is a complete, valid handoff.

evidence.description: Execution evidence that stays in this repository and is referenced, never copied into the site.

presentation.description: Semantic roles carried as a sidecar. Anchors reference text in the body; the body itself is unchanged plain Markdown and is complete without this block.

anchor.description: Exact text from the body. Must match once. A block whose anchor does not match is dropped, never guessed at.
